name: Menu
description: Library allowing game developers to implement custom main menus for their games.
These functions can be used for building game and addon selection UIs, and for loading into a game.
In most cases you won't need to build a game selection UI as the player will have already chosen your game from the engine's launcher menu.

functions.name: listGames
functions.description: Lists all installed games along with their metadata.

functions.name: selectGame
functions.description: Selects a game by its unique slug, to load when calling `loadGame`.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Unique slug of the game to select.

functions.name: deselectGame
functions.description: Deselects the selected game if one is selected.

functions.name: listAddons
functions.description: Lists all installed addons along with their metadata.

functions.name: selectAddon
functions.description: Selects an addon by its unique slug, to load when calling `loadGame`.

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Unique slug of the addon to select.

functions.name: deselectAddon
functions.description: Deselects an addon by its unique slug, to prevent loading when calling `loadGame`.

parameters.name: addon
parameters.description: Unique slug of the addon to deselect.

functions.name: loadGame
functions.description: Flags to the engine that the selected game and addons should be loaded at the end of this tick.

classes.name: PackageMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for a game or addon, collectively referred to as a 'package'.

properties.name: folder
properties.description: Real system path to the package's contents.

properties.name: mountPath
properties.description: Virtual filesystem path where the content will be mounted.

properties.name: coverImagePath
properties.description: Path to a cover image. If the image can't be found, a suitable placeholder should be used.
